title: Italian Poster Art
description: ITALIAN POSTER ART adopted a more cartoon-like look. The design decisions were usually left to local marketing and distribution people who presumably were more attuned to what would best sell the film. While some of the art was fairly true to character; this final oversized poster (back) had Leia as a sultry Gina Lollobrigida-type and Luke looking like he had stepped out of an Italian "spaghetti Western". Both drawings by Papuzza.
